instagram.author: zeinakhaznachi
instagram.body:
Do you get frustrated with this app? Because I certainly do. 😤
I hate being in the spotlight, I hate having to hard sell, I hate having to invite compliments on my work — but as a small business who is competing with organizations that have budgets the size of a country for marketing, I have to keep posting on this freaking app, because last year, I got a lot of new customers from here.

But for the life of me, I cannot crack the code and understand how to grab people’s attention for more than 3 seconds.

So yes — I don’t have much to film for you today, I don’t feel like filming my process, I don’t feel like doing any direct to camera talks… so this is what you’re getting today 🫶🏼
